title: PatientWords interpretability-instrument validity benchmark bundle, v1
description: Structural contract for one benchmark bundle. Written in the keyword subset that scripts/frontend_contract_schema.check_schema_subset accepts ($ref, type, required, properties, items, additionalProperties), so the same file is both documentation and the executed structural check. Value sets (register names, fact statuses, split names, stage names) and every cross-field rule are enforced by scripts/instrument_validity.py and named in docs/protocols/instrument_validity_benchmark.md. The optional description_controls and evaluation_items carry the label and score controls (shuffled and irrelevant descriptions, an explanation-free baseline and cue fields); a bundle without them stays valid and its held-artifact endpoint gets no verdict. A bundle states what an interpretability instrument reported about matched case families; it never states what the model understood. All case and description text in a synthetic bundle is an abstract placeholder.

synthetic.description: True for a software fixture. Version 1 of the scorer admits synthetic bundles only.

execution_status.description: What the bundle claims to be. A synthetic bundle must say synthetic.

seed.description: Non-negative integer. The only source of randomness in the scorer; copied into the report.

stages.description: Keyed by stage name: activation, readout, label, score. Each stage is evaluated on its own. A stage that is not supplied is reported as not_supplied.

held_artifact.description: Description-register manipulation records: the underlying artifact is held fixed and only the register of a meaning-equivalent description varies. Optional per-record fields record each description's token count, formatting class and presentation order.

evaluation_items.description: Optional. The evaluation items of the held artifacts: one row per item, with its truth label, the cues its construction exposes and the scorer's verdict under each description condition. Without them the description controls report control_not_run and the held-artifact endpoint gets no verdict.

analysis_plan.description: Fixed before data. The scorer reads its interval settings and scoring rule from here and nowhere else.

partial_credit.description: Credit for a partially recovered reference fact, between 0 and 1. Recovered scores 1; not recovered and contradicted score 0.

minimum_families_for_verdict.description: At least 2. Below this count of included families the verdict is inconclusive and no interval is computed.

primary_analysis_set.description: validation, fresh_test or held_out (validation plus fresh_test). Never a set that contains discovery families.

prespecified_subsets.description: Subset names declared before data. Version 1 knows one: comparable_behaviour.

prespecified.description: Must be true. A margin chosen after seeing the data refuses.

fixed_before_data.description: Where and when the margins were fixed (a document path, a commit, a date).

endpoints.description: One positive margin per endpoint. Required endpoint: fact_recovery_rate_difference. Required when held_artifact has records: held_artifact_score_difference.

development.description: Which split each tuned element came from. Each value must be discovery.

value.description: Non-negative. A paired absolute difference strictly above it counts as changed.

representation_change.description: Keyed by stage name. A stage without an entry gets an undetermined behaviour-by-representation table.

identities.description: Pinned identities shared by every stage.

behaviour_endpoint.description: Name of the original-model output endpoint recorded as behaviour_value.

reference_fact.description: A fact established independently of the interpretability instrument. The id is the join key; the text is abstract in a synthetic bundle.

base_register.description: Required for within_register_paraphrase and changed_fact: medical or everyday, the variant this one was derived from.

changed_fact_id.description: Required for changed_fact: the one reference fact that no longer holds in this variant.

review_status.description: Clinical-equivalence review status of the family, in words.

observation.description: What one stage reported for one variant. A null is a missing value and is never read as zero.

fact_recovery.description: Keyed by reference fact id: recovered, partially, not_recovered, contradicted, or null when not assessed.

unsupported_facts.description: Count of facts the instrument output asserts that the reference set does not support.

raw_rank.description: Exact-token rank over the full vocabulary, 1-based. A lexical endpoint.

filtered_rank.description: Exact-token rank after the declared vocabulary filter; null when the candidate is excluded or no rank was recorded.

rank_status.description: observed, not_observed_in_window or not_recorded. A top-k miss is not_observed_in_window and is never an absence.

representation_value.description: The stage's scalar summary of the measured representation for this variant (for example a signed component score or a readout probability).

behaviour_value.description: The original model's output endpoint for this variant. It is a property of the model, not of the stage; where several stages record it, the values must agree.

artifact_id.description: The fitted basis, lens, labeler or scorer the stage used.
The artifact held fixed across the two description registers.

artifact_sha256.description: Must be identical on every record of one artifact_id.

stage.description: The stage that accepted the description: label or score.

score.description: The score the description received. Where the artifact's evaluation items carry this register's verdicts, it must equal their balanced accuracy.

description_token_count.description: Optional. Token count of the description under the pinned tokenizer. Reported with every medical-minus-everyday difference; a pair whose counts differ is flagged length_confounded.

formatting_class.description: Optional. Formatting class of the description, in words fixed by the study protocol (for example plain_sentence, bulleted_list). A pair whose classes differ is flagged formatting_differs.

presentation_order.description: Optional. 1 when this description of the artifact was scored first, 2 when second.

verbalizer_arms.description: Optional. For a label or score stage whose instrument reads an activation artifact (a verbalizer, a scorer): what the same system reports for the family's medical and everyday variants when it is given the wording alone (arm input_only) and when it is given a matched control artifact, the same-register artifact of another family fixed by a seeded derangement (arm control_artifact). The stage's own observations are the actual-artifact arm. Added on 2026-11-11; a bundle without it stays valid and the stage's arm state is arms_not_run.

fixed_before_data.description: Where and when the two arm margins were fixed.

margins.description: artifact_minus_input_only and artifact_minus_control_artifact, in fact-recovery rate.

stages.description: Keyed by stage name: label or score.

control_artifact_rule.description: How a control artifact is matched to the actual one (model revision, hook, layer, position class, register), written before data.

verbalizer_arm_observation.description: What the system reported for one paired-register variant under one arm. A null fact status is a missing value and is never read as zero.

variant_id.description: The family's medical or everyday variant.

control_family_id.description: control_artifact rows only: the family whose same-register artifact was supplied.

description_controls.description: Optional. The plan of the description controls at the label and score stages, fixed before data. The scorer refuses a plan that is not prespecified, that names another rule family or another irrelevant description than the rubric's, or whose shuffle mapping is not the seeded derangement.

fixed_before_data.description: Where and when the control margins were fixed.

margins.description: One positive margin for each of matched_minus_shuffled, matched_minus_irrelevant and matched_minus_explanation_free.

seed.description: Non-negative integer. The derangement of stage S is drawn by random.Random('<seed>:shuffle:<S>').

mapping.description: Keyed by stage (label, score), then by artifact_id: the artifact whose description was used as this artifact's shuffled description. A stage without an entry has no shuffled control.

irrelevant_description.description: The rubric's fixed placeholder, copied: placeholder_id and text.

explanation_free_rules.description: The closed rule family, in the rubric's order.

alpha.description: Strictly between 0 and 1. An association is reported as detected when the permutation p-value is at or below it.

evaluation_item.description: One evaluation item of one held artifact. A cue that the scoring task does not expose is omitted or null; it is then reported as not_exposed, never as a pass. A null verdict is a missing value.

artifact_id.description: An artifact_id that has held_artifact records.

label.description: The truth: true when the artifact is active on the scored span.

span_position.description: Position class of the scored span in its window.

span_marking.description: How the scored span is marked for the scorer.

window_token_count.description: Token count of the window shown.

presentation_index.description: 1-based position of the item in the order the scorer saw the artifact's items.

verdicts.description: The scorer's yes or no for this item, keyed by condition: medical, everyday, shuffled_medical, shuffled_everyday, irrelevant.
